snippet.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II Royal Edition – Nintendo Direct 9.9.2026
snippet.description:
Kingdom Come: Deliverance II Royal Edition is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027!

Experience a bold, first-person medieval adventure with a vast open world, grand cinematic story, and visceral combat. The Royal Edition includes all base game content, as well as premium story expansions, exclusive gear, and a bonus questline.

#NintendoDirect #KCD2

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
